- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. With-stringed-instruments. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David.

## 4:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** When-I-call, answer-me, O-God of-my-righteousness. In-distress You-have-made-room for-me. Be-gracious to-me and-hear my-prayer.
- **LOGOS:** Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You gave me relief when I was in distress. Be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
- **PNEUMA:** Answer me when I call to You, my righteous God. You have freed me from tight places before. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
